matrix.title: Visibility Matrix
matrix.empty: There is no active combat with tokens on this scene.
matrix.rowAll: Whole row: this observer sees everyone at this level
matrix.colAll: Whole column: everyone sees this target at this level
matrix.hotkeysHint: Keys 1-5 pick a brush while this window is focused

tooltip.saves: Against effects and saving throws the flat check is rolled manually

rolls.flatCancelled: The attack was cancelled: flat check failed

seekArea.title: Seek: choose an area
seekArea.intro: No targets. Choose the area to search and place it on the map.
seekArea.coneOrigin: The Seek cone must start at the seeker. Place it again.

menu.name: Automation
menu.label: Configure automation
menu.hint: Hide, Sneak, Seek, flat checks and off-guard.

hide.name: Hide
hide.hint: How the module reacts to a Hide roll.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.hint: How the module reacts to a Sneak roll.

seek.name: Seek
seek.hint: How the module reacts to a Seek roll.

observers.name: Observers for Hide / Sneak
observers.hint: Whom a Hide or Sneak roll is checked against.

enabled.name: Flat check on attack
enabled.hint: Roll a flat check when the attacker cannot see the target clearly.

undetected.name: Flat check DC: undetected and unnoticed

onFail.name: On failed flat check
onFail.hint: What happens to the attack when the flat check fails.

who.name: Whose attacks are checked
who.hint: Limit flat checks to player characters or NPCs.

message.name: Flat check message
message.hint: Who sees the flat check result in chat. With a private attack roll the message is whispered to the GM regardless.

spells.name: Flat check for targeted spells
spells.hint: When a spell without an attack roll is cast at targets (not an area), roll a flat check for each target with the same DCs. A failure is reported in chat: the spell does not affect that target; saves and damage are not blocked.

attack.name: Off-guard on attack
attack.hint: A target that the attacker is hidden from is off-guard when the hit is calculated.

damage.name: Off-guard on damage
damage.hint: Pass off-guard to damage rolls (Sneak Attack, precision damage).

onCombatEnd.name: Clear visibility when combat ends
onCombatEnd.hint: Remove all visibility data from tokens when the combat is deleted and when a combatant is removed from it. Tokens still in an active combat are not cleared.

concealedOpacity.name: Concealed token opacity
concealedOpacity.hint: What players see for concealed tokens (0 to 1).

hiddenOpacity.name: Hidden token opacity
hiddenOpacity.hint: What players see for hidden tokens (0 to 1).

hideUndetected.name: Hide undetected tokens
hideUndetected.hint: Hide undetected and unnoticed tokens from players.

hideInTracker.name: Hide undetected in the combat tracker
hideInTracker.hint: Players do not see combatants that are undetected or unnoticed to all of their tokens in the combat tracker.

badge.name: State badge
badge.hint: Show a visibility badge on tokens for players.

gmIndicators.name: GM badges
gmIndicators.hint: Show badges to the GM relative to the selected tokens.

collapseAllies.name: Collapse allies by default
collapseAllies.hint: Collapse PC-PC and NPC-NPC cells when the matrix opens.

allyCriterion.name: Who counts as allies
allyCriterion.hint: Criterion for collapsing allies in the matrix.

hotkeys.name: Matrix hotkeys 1-5
hotkeys.hint: Pick a brush with number keys while the matrix is focused.

tooltip.name: Consequence tooltips
tooltip.hint: Show flat check and off-guard consequences when hovering a matrix cell.

highlight.name: Canvas highlight
highlight.hint: Highlight tokens on the canvas when hovering names and cells.
